title: Review Arrangements for Malay/Muslim Community Development Fund Disbursements
what_it_is: Review Arrangements for Malay/Muslim Community Development Fund Disbursements

sections.label: MMCDF review and matching grant
sections.summary: The 2014 review increased the Government's matching grant and expanded MMCDF's scope; the Secretariat began a new review in August, targeting completion by March 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The last review was conducted in 2014 and saw an increase in the Government's matching grant, as well as an expansion in the scope of MMCDF to help our Malay/Muslim organisations build capabilities and improve organisational development.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The Community Leaders Forum Secretariat, based in the Council on Education for Muslim Children (MENDAKI), manages and regularly reviews the operational aspects of MMCDF, including its funding guidelines and processes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The Secretariat started work on the latest round of reviews in August last year and targets to complete the review by March 2017.
